insight: Founded in 2021 in Washington, DC; has raised about $20.5M and counts Fortune 100 firms among its customers.
name: Capitol AI
tagline: Agentic AI platform for turning proprietary data into decision-grade artifacts.
description: Capitol is an agentic AI platform that turns proprietary data and expert judgment into trusted, decision-grade artifacts — due-diligence reports, regulatory documentation, and executive briefings. Built for regulated, high-stakes institutions in financial services, professional services, and government, it runs entirely inside enterprise infrastructure with no data egress and keeps every output auditable. It is model-agnostic, working with whichever LLMs an organization approves, and exposes a web interface plus an API and SDK for builders.
